answer.book: Lavater's commentary in 38 homilies (Homiliae I-XXXVIII) on the first book of Ezra, Zurich 1586: a dedicatory epistle, the homilies arranged under the ten chapters of Ezra, and two indexes (rerum et verborum; locorum Sacrae Scripturae) at the back.
